name: Rishabh Instruments Ltd
title: Rishabh Instruments Ltd - 543977 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Rishabh's FY26 margin recovery is real (consolidated EBITDA ₹1,264m, 16.3% margin), but FY27 guidance is EEI 20-25% growth at 20-22% margin and Alucast revenue below ₹200cr with no loss, while capacity is doubling at Nashik.

capex.quote: These facilities will effectively double our production capacity, enhancing our ability to meet rising export and domestic demand

triggers.label: Nashik capacity doubles
triggers.quote: These facilities will effectively double our production capacity

triggers.label: EEI growth 20-25% FY27
triggers.quote: we are looking at anywhere between 20% to 25% around 20% top line growth

triggers.label: US revenue USD3m, target +40-50%
triggers.quote: now this year, we are planning to get into another 40%, 50% growth

triggers.label: Alucast revenue to fall below ₹200cr
triggers.quote: we are saying in FY 27, we will be below INR200 crores, right?

guidance.quote: we are looking at anywhere between 20% to 25% around 20% top line growth
we want to commit 20% to 22% as the EBITDA
around INR150 crores, INR160 crores is what we can expect as a broader guideline

guidance.value: below INR180-200 crore, flattish, no losses
guidance.quote: we still want to give the same guideline like we want to not lose money and also there may not be growth
We are looking for INR25 crores -- INR24 crores, INR25 crores business in the coming financial year.

prior_guidance_check.quote: consolidated EBITDA reaching to INR 126 crores and adjusted EBITDA reaching to INR 136 crores in FY '26, overreaching on the earlier commitment of INR 110 crores

prior_guidance_check.metric: EEI margin 20-22% (same as last year guideline)
prior_guidance_check.quote: we maintain the same level of profitability at all the companies
On the positive side, we don't have anything loss-making.
Next year will be something where we are looking at getting double-digit number, not this financial year, next financial year.

red_flags.label: Alucast revenue down ~21-24%, loss-making legacy contracts exited
red_flags.quote: the turnover shrunk by 21% in Polish currency during the year

red_flags.label: Solar inverter not cost-competitive vs Chinese
red_flags.quote: Not yet. We are close to it, but I mean, if we really want to make profits, we are not.

red_flags.label: Alucast demerger possibility not ruled out
red_flags.quote: that's a possible scenario also, but we are not committed yes or no on that

evasions.quote: that's something which we don't want to commit either yes or no
Next year will be something where we are looking at getting double-digit number, not this financial year, next financial year.
crossing INR1,000 crores may not be what we want to say now on the top line
